slot_scores.name: missing_minimize_hours_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total hours worked by the selected workers (i.e., the sum of the hours for the four task assignments), or is there a different objective such as minimizing the maximum hours any single worker works?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is minimizing total hours worked, directly covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: worker_at_most_one_task_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single selected worker be assigned more than one of the four tasks, or must each of the four tasks go to a different worker (meaning one selected worker would be left with no task)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether a selected worker can take multiple tasks, covering the exactly-one-task-per-worker constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 and P1 hidden slots were resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved high-severity slots remained.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved the objective and the one-task-per-worker constraint before stopping, resulting in a clean and appropriate clarification process.
